description:
Bill of Materials for ioc-unit. Import this pom (scope=import) in a consumer's
        dependencyManagement to pin every ioc-unit artifact to a single, consistent version
        without pinning versions of the WildFly/Jakarta APIs that ioc-unit itself only
        requires as "provided". Those must keep coming from the consumer's own WildFly BOM
        (org.wildfly.bom:wildfly-ee-with-tools / wildfly-expansion-with-tools) so no
        duplicate/conflicting Jakarta or Hibernate versions end up on the classpath. Likewise,
        junit/mockito/hamcrest/logback/javassist are the ioc-unit reactor's own build/test
        dependencies and are deliberately NOT re-exposed here - consumers own their own test
        stack versions.
